headline.text: L3 Truffle speed-up belt found with *severe fold and cut* — running for now, maintenance reviewing options for Monday.

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 ran caramel products across all lines with two brief stoppages on Sollich 4 — both cleared inside 20 minutes. Level 2 cleans completed overnight.
per_plant_summary.L2: L2 cleared a film tear on FFS in 15 minutes but left two changeover issues open for Monday: snack-size parts unknown and an inkjet alignment problem on ML2.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 completed level 2 cleans on ML1, ML4, and Truffle. A Truffle belt was found folded over with a cut at 07:12 — severe damage but still running, awaiting maintenance decision.

notes.text: Scissor lift died during tarp removal work and was put on charge.
Warehouse staged three different lots of cases for FFS Monday start — Zack labeled them for crew visibility.

resolved.title: S4 caramel tangling causing double pieces
resolved.summary: Caramel on the line tangled and caused double pieces at the pack end; operators cleared it inside 20 minutes.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 16:26 — "Problem fixed. Thank you" (Penny Akins).

resolved.title: S4 THG wrapper stopping intermittently
resolved.summary: The THG wrapper kept stopping for unknown reasons; Caleb York and Bryant diagnosed and re-taught the wrapper gap print detect sensor.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 17:14 — sensor re-taught, wrapper running (Caleb York).

resolved.title: FFS film tore inside machine
resolved.summary: Film tore on the shoulder and had to be re-routed; operators took the line down to re-thread and brought it back up in 15 minutes.
resolved.resolution: Line up at 18:59 — "Line is up" (Gustavo Rodas).

resolved.title: ML4 line down, all servos turned on
resolved.summary: The line stopped at 12:58 with all servos turning on; crew reset and had it running again inside 9 minutes.

resolved.title: ML1 inclusion hopper vacuum dropped and wire damaged
resolved.summary: The ring clamp popped open while moving the hopper vacuum, causing it to drop and rip the wire off; Kavin repaired the wire on-site.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 04:42 — "The wire on the inclusion hopper has been fixed by Kavin" (Phillip Perez).

resolved.title: Truffle chicane belt tracking alarm during post-clean check
resolved.summary: Belt tracking alarm sounded 13 minutes into the post-clean belt run; Jose adjusted tracking and ran an additional 15 minutes with no issues.
resolved.resolution: Cleared after adjustment — ran 15 more minutes, no issues (Phillip Perez, 05:49).

resolved.title: ML1 rice hopper sensor bracket bent, reading incorrectly
resolved.summary: The sensor bracket was bent and the sensor wasn't reading correctly; Kavin adjusted the bracket back into place.
resolved.resolution: Fixed at 06:42 — "Got back into place" (Kavin Ayala).

needs_attention.title: ML2 speed roller belts bottomed out on tension adjustment
needs_attention.summary: Speed roller belts are all loose as if not the same size; Fernando adjusted them to get them running but the adjustments are maxed out with no room left.
needs_attention.status: Belts running as of 18:48 but "bottomed out on the adjustments" — no margin remaining.

needs_attention.title: FFS changeover to snack size incomplete, parts unknown
needs_attention.summary: Lance was unsure which parts are needed to complete the snack-size changeover; Zack elected to wait until Monday rather than guess and risk further delay.
needs_attention.status: Chocolate and film staged, one pallet of cases on hand, changeover incomplete as of 05:36.

needs_attention.title: ML2 inkjet printer code date won't fit inside flow-wrap
needs_attention.summary: Maintenance couldn't adjust the inkjet to fit the code date inside the wrapper boundary; line lead can adjust it manually but issue needs addressing Monday.
needs_attention.status: Changeover to 12g otherwise complete; line lead workaround available, setup needs fixing at Monday startup.

needs_attention.title: Truffle speed-up belt folded over with severe cut
needs_attention.summary: The belt on the speed-up table after the Gallatin was found folded over with a cut during post-clean inspection; damage described as severe but belt is running.
needs_attention.status: Running as of 07:12 but "damage is severe" — Rose asked Blake and Chris for thoughts at 09:11, no resolution posted.

needs_attention.title: ML4 TG4 filter vacuum cleaning not finished, causing rejects
needs_attention.summary: The filter vacuum was left incomplete from the prior clean; operator noted this is why the line has issues with rejected chocolate and will clean it this time.
needs_attention.status: Operator flagged at 04:57, will clean during this cycle.
